parts:

Regards,

messages.author: f9e5f5f7804ba41a
messages.subject: Re: Idea: Visual Studio Code extension for R
parts:
Thank you for your interest.

Yes, actually Microsoft support for Visual Studio.
It is a different editor.
I developed support function for Visual Studio **Code**.

Using VS Code, you can get some benefits. 
* You can get same function on cross-platform (Windows, Linux, Mac)
* You can use other programming languages on same folder (R with Python, R with Javascript)

Yuki
